articles.title: Lift at Derker Tram Stop Out of Service Until Further Notice
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers. Alternative step-free access routes are available for travel towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 7:32pm on Thursday, 27 August 2026, and will remain unavailable until further notice. This disruption affects passengers using the tram stop for travel towards Manchester and Rochdale.

For customers travelling towards Manchester, step-free access is available via a ramp from Cromford Street directly to the Manchester-bound platform. Passengers heading away from Manchester can also use a ramp from Cromford Street, followed by a track crossing to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester has issued an apology for any inconvenience caused by this service disruption. Passengers are advised to plan their journeys accordingly and consider alternative routes if necessary.

Further updates regarding the lift's status will be provided as they become available. For more information, visit the Transport for Greater Manchester website.

articles.title: Police Investigate Dog Attack on Sheep at Piethorne Reservoir, Milnrow
articles.excerpt: Police are seeking witnesses following a dog attack on sheep near Piethorne Reservoir, resulting in one sheep's death. The incident occurred on 18 August at 8.45pm.
articles.content_html:
BREAKING NEWS — LIVE

Live updates, newest first.

13:41, 27 August 2026

Police are seeking witnesses following a dog attack on sheep near Piethorne Reservoir, resulting in one sheep's death. The incident occurred on 18 August at 8.45pm.

Police are appealing for witnesses after a dog attacked sheep near Piethorne Reservoir in Milnrow, leading to the death of one sheep. The incident occurred at approximately 8.45pm on 18 August 2026, according to Greater Manchester Police (GMP).

Officers have released an image of a man they wish to speak to in connection with the attack, as they believe he may have information that could assist their investigation. GMP stated, "Officers are appealing for information regarding reports of a dog attacking sheep resulting in one of them dying."

Anyone with information is encouraged to contact GMP by calling 101 or using the LiveChat service, quoting log number 18/08/2026. Alternatively, information can be provided anonymously to Crimestoppers at 0800 555 111.

The incident highlights the ongoing concerns regarding dog attacks on livestock in rural areas, which can have serious consequences for farmers and animal welfare. Local residents are urged to keep their dogs on leads when near livestock to prevent similar incidents.

articles.title: Rochdale Students Achieve Higher GCSE Grades in 2026
articles.excerpt: The latest GCSE results show an increase in higher grades among Rochdale students, with notable improvements in core subjects like English and maths.
articles.content_html:
More pupils across Rochdale are achieving higher grades in their GCSEs, according to the latest results released on 27 August 2026. The data reveals that 55.2% of Year 11 students passed more than five subjects, including both English and maths, marking a significant improvement in academic performance.

In English, 56.3% of students achieved a strong pass, defined as grades 5 to 9, while in maths, 47.5% of learners reached similar standards. Additionally, 60.6% of students passed two sciences, reflecting a 5.9% increase from the previous academic year.

The results also highlight success in modern languages, with 70.5% of students passing subjects such as French, Spanish, or German, an increase of 17.2% since 2024. In humanities, 52.5% of students passed their geography and history exams, up from 48.1% in 2025.

The borough's cared-for young people also demonstrated notable success, with a 3% increase in the number of pupils passing their exams, including a 4% rise in English and maths. These results indicate a positive trend in educational outcomes for students in Rochdale.
